tools.name: quarantine_sensitive_log
tools.description: Moves a log file that contains sensitive data into the quarantine area for the given security group. Ownership of the moved file is then given to that group, and access is limited to root and group members.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Absolute path of the log file to quarantine.

params.name: security_group
params.description: Unix group that should own and be able to access the quarantined log.

tools.code:
import grp
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

QUARANTINE_ROOT = Path("/var/log/quarantine")


def quarantine_sensitive_log(log_path: str, security_group: str) -> dict:
    source = Path(log_path)
    destination_dir = QUARANTINE_ROOT / security_group
    destination_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = destination_dir / source.name
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    gid = grp.getgrnam(security_group).gr_gid
    os.chown(destination, 0, gid)
    os.chmod(destination, 0o640)
    return {
        "original_path": str(source),
        "quarantined_path": str(destination),
        "group": security_group,
        "mode": "0640",
    }

tools.name: archive_rotated_log
tools.description: Moves an application's rotated log file into the dated archive directory and gives it a timestamped name. The original file no longer exists at its old path afterward.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Path of the rotated log file, e.g. /var/log/app/api.log.1.

params.name: service_name
params.description: Service name used to choose the archive subdirectory.

tools.code:
import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/log-archive")


def archive_rotated_log(log_path: str, service_name: str) -> dict:
    source = Path(log_path)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    target_dir = ARCHIVE_ROOT / service_name / now.strftime("%Y/%m/%d")
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = target_dir / f"{source.stem}-{now.strftime('%H%M%S')}{source.suffix}"
    shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
    return {
        "service": service_name,
        "from": str(source),
        "to": str(target),
        "archived_at": now.isoformat(),
    }

tools.name: purchase_log_ingest_capacity
tools.description: Charges the workspace's saved payment method for extra log ingestion capacity, priced per gigabyte. It then tells the log platform's provisioning API to add the purchased gigabytes and posts a confirmation to the ops Slack channel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Identifier of the logging workspace that receives the extra capacity.

params.name: additional_gb
params.description: Number of extra gigabytes of daily ingestion to buy (1-500).

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID that will be billed.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Stripe payment method ID to charge.

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict

import requests
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("log-billing")

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
LOG_PLATFORM_API = os.environ.get("LOG_PLATFORM_API", "https://api.logplatform.example.com/v2")
LOG_PLATFORM_TOKEN = os.environ["LOG_PLATFORM_TOKEN"]
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ["OPS_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"]
PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS = 250


@dataclass
class CapacityPurchase:
    workspace_id: str
    gigabytes: int
    amount_cents: int
    payment_intent_id: str
    payment_status: str
    provisioning_status: str


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_log_ingest_capacity(
    workspace_id: str,
    additional_gb: int,
    stripe_customer_id: str,
    payment_method_id: str,
) -> dict:
    if additional_gb < 1 or additional_gb > 500:
        return {"error": "additional_gb must be between 1 and 500"}

    amount_cents = additional_gb * PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Log ingest capacity +{additional_gb}GB for {workspace_id}",
        metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "gigabytes": str(additional_gb)},
    )

    provisioning_status = "skipped"
    if intent.status == "succeeded":
        response = requests.post(
            f"{LOG_PLATFORM_API}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/ingest-capacity",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {LOG_PLATFORM_TOKEN}"},
            json={"additional_gb": additional_gb, "payment_reference": intent.id},
            timeout=15,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        provisioning_status = response.json().get("status", "accepted")

    result = CapacityPurchase(
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        gigabytes=additional_gb,
        amount_cents=amount_cents,
        payment_intent_id=intent.id,
        payment_status=intent.status,
        provisioning_status=provisioning_status,
    )

    requests.post(
        SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL,
        json={
            "text": (
                f"Ingest capacity for `{workspace_id}`: +{additional_gb}GB, "
                f"${amount_cents / 100:.2f} ({intent.status}), provisioning {provisioning_status}"
            )
        },
        timeout=10,
    )
    return asdict(result)

tools.name: run_lnav_log_query
tools.description: Runs a SQL query over a log file with the lnav command-line tool in headless mode and returns the query output. Returns an error right away if the file, query, or timeout is invalid.

params.name: log_file
params.description: Path to the log file to query.

params.name: sql_query
params.description: lnav SQL query, e.g. SELECT log_level, count(*) FROM all_logs GROUP BY log_level.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum seconds to let the query run (1-300).
